name: PocketMobs | SEASON 1 | The #1 Bedrock Pokémon Server
description:
PocketMobs is a Pokémon server for Minecraft Bedrock, on phone, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch and PC.

Season 1 is live: join before December 4 and keep the exclusive Founder cape forever.

Type /redeem POCKETPAL for a Shiny Eevee and an exclusive cape.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Catch over 1,100 Pokémon with real catch rates, and battle with real Pokémon battle rules

- Pick your starter from every generation, Gen 1 to Gen 9

- Beat walk-through gyms with puzzles, parkour and trainers before the leader, and earn your badges

- Explore Johto and Kanto on one map, on foot, with the story, rivals and Team Rocket

- Climb Victory Road, face Cynthia, then the Elite Four

- Fight giant raid bosses with friends

- Find legendaries in the wild, with their own cutscenes

- Play the Battle Tower, the Battle Factory, the Safari Zone and the villain hideouts

- Build your base: Pokémon work and sleep in beds, eggs and an incubator, berry farming

- Fair economy, trading and an auction house

- Vote every day for a Poké Crate key and coins, with a bonus for a 7-day streak

HOW TO JOIN

- Phone / PC: Play > Servers > Add Server > play.pocketmobs.com, port 19132

- Xbox / PlayStation / Switch: add the friend Pocketmobs, then Play > Friends tab > join PocketMobs

- Walk through PLAY in the lobby, then /redeem POCKETPAL

Help, events and updates: https://discord.gg/baFFzNFXCr

Store: https://store.pocketmobs.com
